## Ctx.userLanguage property

The user's language code from Telegram (e.g., "en", "id").

**Signature:**

```typescript
get userLanguage(): string;

set userLanguage(v: string);
```

## Remarks

This property can be both read and written. Setting this value overrides the language used for template rendering.

## Example


```typescript
async callback() {
  console.log(this.userLanguage) // "en"
  this.userLanguage = "id" // Override to Indonesian
}
```
